result.summary: The street features sidewalks on both sides, though they are narrow and contain obstructions like utility poles and outdoor furniture. A signalized intersection is visible in the distance with faded crosswalk markings, but the overall environment lacks robust pedestrian-priority infrastructure or buffers from traffic.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles on the right sidewalk and outdoor seating on the left narrow the effective walking width.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the street in the foreground and midground

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalks
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings at the intersection ahead are significantly worn, reducing visibility to drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: Pedestrians on the narrow sidewalk are directly adjacent to moving traffic without a planting strip or physical barrier.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded markings with continental or ladder-style high-visibility paint at the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk where possible and relocate utility poles to ensure a clear, accessible path of travel.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a continuous paved sidewalk that lacks a buffer from the roadway. The pedestrian environment is currently impacted by debris and trash bins obstructing the walkway, and visibility is partially obscured by parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: A blue recycling bin and cardboard boxes are placed on the sidewalk, narrowing the effective walking width and creating a potential tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image on the sidewalk in front of the white fence.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb with no planting strip or physical barrier to separate pedestrians from moving or parked vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire visible length of the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer / Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Waste Management Regulation
interventions.description: Implement or enforce policies for the placement of waste bins to ensure they do not obstruct the clear path of travel on sidewalks.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with row houses and parallel parking on both sides. While sidewalks are present, they lack buffers from traffic and are occasionally obstructed by utility poles and waste bins.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars along both sides of the street block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles and recycling bins narrow the effective walking width of the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at intersections to improve visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalks to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming to ensure low vehicle speeds in this residential area.

result.summary: The image shows a typical residential row-house street with a continuous paved sidewalk. While the pedestrian path is clear of major structural gaps, it lacks safety enhancements such as street lighting, marked crossings, or a buffer from the roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk debris
hazards.description: A large piece of cardboard or wood is obstructing a portion of the walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: On the sidewalk in front of the brick row house.

hazards.name: Poor roadway pavement
hazards.description: The street surface is cracked and uneven, which could pose a tripping hazard for pedestrians crossing mid-block.

hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: No street light poles are visible, which may reduce pedestrian safety and visibility at night.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during night hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Regular removal of debris and maintenance of the walking surface to ensure a clear path.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the degraded asphalt to provide a smoother surface for all users.
